::: {.callout-note}
## Category Overview & Scope
다양한 시점의 2차원 관측 이미지들로부터 사실적인 3차원 세상을 복원하고 렌더링하는 기법들을 다룹니다.

* **Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF):** Implicit Volume Rendering, Positional Encoding, Instant-NGP, Mip-NeRF 360
* **3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS):** Explicit 3D Gaussian Primitive, Differentiable Tile Rasterizer, Densification & Pruning
* **Visual SLAM & SfM:** Structure-from-Motion (COLMAP), Visual Odometry, Neural SLAM, Gaussian SLAM
* **Point Cloud & Mesh:** PointNet, PointNet++, Mesh Reconstruction, TSDF Fusion
:::
